used_propositions: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Companies House / Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
CRM still shows the old English-facing name for Oakfield.
MSA-OAK-2018 names its counterparty as Oakfield Logistics GmbH.
support_claim: Rebranding evidence links Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH via unchanged HRB 88421, but unresolved preservation of multiple live naming variants blocks closing whether billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH and contract:MSA-OAK-2018 denote the same counterparty.
